name: Bluffton University
academic_ranking: Small private university (United Methodist / Mennonite affiliated liberal arts) in Bluffton, OH. Total enrollment approximately 867 with an 11:1 student-to-faculty ratio and roughly 67% acceptance rate (source: College Factual, checked 2026-07).
financial_aid: As an NCAA Division III program, Bluffton does not offer athletic scholarships; aid is need- and merit-based academic/institutional financial aid. Average net cost reported around $19,943/year (College Factual, checked 2026-07). Tuition & fees figure ($37,362, 2024-25) is a combined tuition-and-fees sticker price per Univstats.
facilities_notes: Softball played at Bluffton University's on-campus softball facility. Official athletics site (blufftonbeavers.com) blocked automated fetch (HTTP 403) at time of research 2026-07; specific facility details not independently confirmed from a live page.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference (HCAC). Paige Jansen has led the program as head coach since being named in August 2021.
notes: Official athletics domain is blufftonbeavers.com (the provided gobeavers.bluffton.edu host did not resolve). Live official coaches/roster pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; coaching staff and roster size were corroborated via third-party recruiting/statistics directories (OfferSecured verified March 2026, College Factual) and DuckDuckGo search snippets. Two-person softball staff confirmed by multiple sources; no graduate assistants, volunteer coaches, or separate recruiting coordinator listed. Roster size 19 per College Factual participant count.
